assumptions.statement: Supplier B's force-majeure stoppages over 2026-2028 repeat the last three years: two events, of 9 and 14 days
assumptions.rationale: Only history available (supply risk review); a two-event sample is small, so the break-even C0015 is shown
assumptions.owner: Chief procurement officer (validate with Supplier B's plant risk audit before signing)

assumptions.statement: Stoppage cost scales with the share of volume on Supplier B; no incumbent cover is credited because cover needs two weeks' notice and stoppages last 9-14 days
assumptions.rationale: Applies the same risk to every option in proportion to its Supplier B exposure (protocol 1.2)

assumptions.statement: The 1.1 EUR M rush freight persists in every option and no unit-price reduction applies to it
assumptions.rationale: Finance note; the freight comes from our own forecast errors, not supplier pricing

assumptions.statement: The 2025 spend base excluding rush freight (23.9 EUR M) holds flat over 2026-2028
assumptions.rationale: No volume or price forecast in the sources
